**Do not attach videos, keyframes, hand-made scripts or API keys. / 請勿附上影片、關鍵幀、人工腳本或 API 金鑰。**

- Version (shown in the web UI footer or `funscript_gen.__version__`) / 版本:
- How you run it (CLI / web UI / Windows build / Docker), OS / 執行方式與系統:
- What you did, what you expected, what happened / 做了什麼、預期、實際:
- Log or error text (remove paths, URLs and keys) / 紀錄或錯誤訊息（移除路徑、網址與金鑰）:
